description: Nesher c/n S-17, on charge 21 June 1980, entered ARMACUAR for overhaul 24 September 1997 and never flew again; recovered 2005 and installed on the costanera in March 2006 with a Mirage 5P nose, painted as C-421. Photographed 15 January 2023.
aliases: Nesher; Mirage 5; Finger; C-421; c/n S-17; C421
